column3: Kirino Route · There's No Way My Little Sister Wouldn't Accept A Souvenir
Ahh, at any rate, today was sure a tiring day.
It's rare that I have a school trip to reinvigorate myself with, so I'll make my little sister happy on this rare occasion! Even though that's how I felt,
Doesn't she know how embarrassing it was just to buy them?
...You think I went this far because I wanted to see Kirino's happy face?
Hah, don't joke with me. I actually hate that girl, and she should feel the same too.
Well, it does seem like she's slightly more thankful to me, but her attitude sure hasn't changed.
...Although we do understand each other a little better now, the relationship between my little sister and I will always be like this in the end.
*yawn*... No good, I'm already at my limit. I'll go to sleep now...
For the first time in a few days, I fell asleep at home.
